CSS Conditional Rules Module Level 5

5. Container Queries

Size container queries allow styling elements based on the size of a query container rather than the viewport.

Tests

container-width.html

Example: @container (min-width: 400px) { .card { display: grid; } }

Note: This note is non-normative.

5.1. Establishing Query Containers

The container-type property establishes an element as a query container for the specified axes.

5.2. Naming Query Containers

The container-name property specifies a list of query container names.
